claim_evidence.statement: SELECT id, measurement_id, statistical_result_id FROM evidence_relations WHERE claim_version_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

governance_target.statement: SELECT id FROM audit_findings WHERE project_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AND target_type = 'artifact_version' AND target_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'

correction_target.statement: SELECT id FROM correction_records WHERE project_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' AND target_type = 'artifact_version' AND target_id = '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' ORDER BY created_at, id

interpretation: The sparse audit database produces sequential scans for two empty-table probes and an index-only scan for the correction-record ordering probe. No frozen invariant requires a proactive index solely to alter these sparse-data plans.
